texts: mixed: the belief, the quantification over every Keeper and the becoming-wraiths are all captured and the rule fires, but "the dead of the storm-surge" has no licensed relation, so the parse falls back on a loose possession link that says only that the dead are somehow the surge's, never that the surge killed them. Say the dying outright: "Every Keeper believes that the people who died in the storm-surge became wraiths." That gives a real dying event tied to the surge, and the rest of the parse (the belief rule, the change into wraiths, the per-member distribution) stays exactly as it is.
